key.name: station-mode
key.description: How to pick the PWS station. 'home' always uses the home station; 'auto' resolves the nearest PWS from your current location.

key.name: home-station
key.description: Weather Underground station ID used in home mode and as fallback in auto mode. Set your own station in preferences.

key.name: home-lat
key.description: Latitude of your home location for the auto-mode geofence. Set your own in preferences.

key.name: home-lon
key.description: Longitude of your home location for the auto-mode geofence. Set your own in preferences.

key.name: home-radius-km
key.description: In auto mode, the home station is used when you're within this distance of home. Beyond it, the nearest PWS to your location is used.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often to refresh weather data. Default 900 (15 minutes). Minimum 60.

key.name: show-label
key.description: Whether the top bar button shows the temperature text.
